title: Core Octet #06
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, eight women in a single row.

A photograph of EIGHT women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 8 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[yamikawa / Brazilian Booty]: Japanese woman, late 20s, cool and composed, pale, almost translucent skin, heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips, a hollow, half-lidded expression, bright golden-blonde hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, stiletto nails (glittery). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel (a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: reclining on her side, propped on one elbow. Shoes: extreme gold extreme platform high heels.

[glamorous party / Black Glamour]: Korean woman, early 50s, cool and composed, fair ivory skin, smoky eyes in champagne-gold glitter shadow, a sharp winged liner, full lashes, softly contoured cheekbones with a glowing highlight, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy gradient lips in deep rose, a confident, luminous expression, sleek silver-grey hair styled in half-up, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below, stiletto nails (glittery). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back. Shoes: extreme cobalt-and-coral ballet heels.

[Slavic glam / Legend Bust]: Russian woman, late 50s, sultry, very fair, cool skin, sculpted feathered dark brows, a precise winged liner, soft taupe eyeshadow, long lashes, large pale eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour and a bright highlighter along the cheekbones and nose bridge, glossy nude-pink lips, a cold, striking expression, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, oval nails (chrome). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward. Shoes: extreme gold needle heels.

[German Glam / Powerlifter]: German woman, early 40s, cool and composed, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in a chin-length bob, oval nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman. Colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame. Not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: both arms raised overhead. Shoes: extreme gold-leaf platform stiletto Mary Janes.

[West African party-glam / Amazoness]: Nigerian woman, mid 20s, cheerful, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, square nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: back fully to camera. Shoes: extreme cobalt-and-coral plain stiletto pumps.

[Turkish Glam / USSBBW]: Turkish woman, early 30s, demure and soft, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a short pixie cut, oval nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip. Shoes: extreme cobalt extreme platform clear heels.

[Yoruba bridal / Hourglass SSBBW]: Yoruba Nigerian woman, early 30s, bold and confident, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in a high top-knot bun, stiletto nails (glittery). Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back. Shoes: extreme gold ankle-strap stilettos.

[Ao Dai Glam / Heavy Muscle]: Vietnamese woman, late 50s, sultry, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, cool ash-grey hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, stiletto nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Polish Bolesławiec pottery (a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward. Shoes: extreme white platform stiletto studded boots.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 8, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
